connectors.words: and, also, moreover, furthermore, besides, in addition, likewise, similarly, indeed, in fact
connectors.rule: The blank matches the polarity of the first half. If the first half is positive, the blank is positive.

connectors.words: but, however, yet, although, though, even though, despite, in spite of, nevertheless, nonetheless, whereas, while, on the contrary, on the other hand, conversely
connectors.rule: The blank is the opposite polarity. This is the single most common pattern in the paper.

connectors.words: because, since, as, owing to, due to, for
connectors.rule: The blank explains what came before.

connectors.words: so, therefore, hence, thus, consequently, as a result, accordingly
connectors.rule: The blank is the result of what came before.

connectors.words: if, unless, provided that, in case, otherwise
connectors.rule: Unless already means 'if not' — never add another negative.

connectors.words: for instance, for example, such as, namely
connectors.rule: The blank is a specific case of the general statement before it.

connectors.words: first, then, next, afterwards, finally, meanwhile, subsequently
connectors.rule: Order in time; rarely changes polarity.
